verdict.rationale: All MCP-related evidence describes Pipedream acting as an MCP *server* — exposing its own 3,000+ APIs/tools so external agents/clients can call them (pipedream-docs-3, pipedream-docs-5, pipedream-docs-34, pipedream-docs-38) — not as a client that lets a user plug external MCP servers into Pipedream so it can consume their tools. No evidence shows Pipedream's workflow/agent builder importing or connecting to third-party MCP servers.
